combo_label: At the Supermarket × Sailing & Boats × The Titanic

entries.clue: Black fuel in her bunkers, one of them with a fire smouldering in it as she sailed
Cycle of shifts pinned up in the staff room, telling you whose Sunday it is
Cabins so described are the ones nearest the stern, farthest from the bow
Tall upright spar rising from the deck to carry sail
Ten per cent a staff card earns you at the counter, straight off the bill
The M of her R.M.S.; five clerks drowned hauling sacks of it from the sorting room
Biggest workhorse in a yacht's wardrobe of canvas, hoisted up the tallest spar
Distress letters the operators tapped out alongside the older call CQD
Open-fronted cabinet for yoghurt and cream, held a few degrees above zero
Great Atlantic passenger ship of the kind Lusitania and Mauretania also were
Scribbled before you leave home, then ticked off item by item
Huge balloon of light nylon bellied out ahead when the wind is behind
